abilities.effect: A fiery geyser of flaming gas explodes from the ground. Creatures within 5 feet of the flue take 4d10 fire damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save); creatures that fail the save also take 4d10 persistent fire damage.
abilities.name: Flame Spurt
abilities.trigger: A creature moves within 5 feet of the flue

hazard.description: Invisible but highly flammable natural gas has built up beneath the ground, where geological pressure can ignite it.
hazard.disable: Survival DC 28 to dig around the vent in a way that diffuses the fumes
hazard.name: Methane Flue

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
